evidence: Read cold, task/instruction.md is five short prose paragraphs in a firm's first-person voice with the business motive first: line 1 'Kittle & Rowe is a small law firm, and our clients keep emailing documents to whoever answered last. We want a secure chat where each client talks to us inside their legal matter...'; line 3 ranks priorities as a person would ('Two things matter more than anything else. First, ethical walls... Second, retention...'); line 9 'Before you hand it over, please try it the way we'll use it: sign in as different people, post, reply, edit, search and open a transcript'. Grep for numbered/bulleted lists, 'shall', or tables in instruction.md finds none; the only 'must' uses (line 3) are natural emphasis. It names no framework, file layout or endpoint list; the only paths are the seed file, the notes folder and the /app/server.js entry required by the runtime contract (row 4). The detail is delegated to /instructions notes that stay in the same voice and give reasons for rules ('Our clients ask several things at once' conversations.md:5; 'Our internet in court is patchy' conversations.md:29; 'a leak is a professional-conduct problem for us' walls-and-retention.md:17; 'The firm runs on a fixed clock... which is why we care that the order stays consistent' integration.md:7). The only table is the demo account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11), expected by profile. integration.md:3 states runtime facts (Node 22, 0.0.0.0:3000, Express/better-sqlite3 preinstalled, SQLite at /app/app.db or DB_PATH, GET /api/health) as 'how we run it' operational facts, which check 4 requires to be stated; this is a runtime contract, not a build recipe or endpoint list. Observation (not a defect): the notes are rule-dense (~1,490 words with many precise conditions such as 'at least three levels deep', 'about five seconds', '390 px'), but each is phrased as the firm's practice with a reason, not as acceptance criteria. Adversarial: this prose row has no app-execution dimension; a broken app cannot pass or fail it, and a conforming alternative app is not penalized by the brief's style. The brief also leaks no grader framing that would make it read as a spec. No runtime evidence is required for this row.
